description.en: In aniline, the lone pair of electrons on the nitrogen atom is delocalized over the benzene ring. This makes the nitrogen less electron-rich (less basic) and increases electron density at the ortho and para positions, making the ring highly reactive towards electrophilic substitution.
description.hi: एनिलीन में, नाइट्रोजन परमाणु पर इलेक्ट्रॉनों का एकाकी युग्म बेंजीन वलय पर विस्थानिकृत (delocalized) हो जाता है। यह नाइट्रोजन को कम इलेक्ट्रॉन-समृद्ध (कम क्षारीय) बनाता है और ऑर्थो और पैरा स्थितियों पर इलेक्ट्रॉन घनत्व बढ़ाता है, जिससे वलय इलेक्ट्रॉनरागी प्रतिस्थापन के प्रति अत्यधिक क्रियाशील हो जाता है।
description.hinglish: Aniline mein nitrogen ka lone pair benzene ring par delocalize hota hai. Isse nitrogen less basic ho jata hai aur ortho/para positions par electron density badh jati hai.

<svg viewBox="0 0 800 200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Structure 1 -->
  <g transform="translate(50, 50)">
    <!-- Benzene Ring -->
    <polygon points="30,40 60,40 75,70 60,100 30,100 15,70" fill="none" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <!-- Double bonds -->
    <line x1="35" y1="45" x2="55" y2="45" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="65" y1="72" x2="55" y2="92" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="25" y1="92" x2="15" y2="72" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    
    <!-- NH2 group -->
    <line x1="45" y1="40" x2="45" y2="15" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="45" y="10" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2563eb" text-anchor="middle">NH₂</text>
    <!-- Lone pair -->
    <circle cx="35" cy="0" r="2" fill="#2563eb" />
    <circle cx="40" cy="-2" r="2" fill="#2563eb" />
    
    <!-- Arrows -->
    <path d="M 38 5 Q 55 10 50 30" fill="none" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
    <path d="M 50 45 Q 70 45 75 60" fill="none" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
  </g>

  <!-- Resonance Arrow 1 -->
  <g transform="translate(140, 110)">
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="30" y2="0" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="2" marker-start="url(#arrow-rev)" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
  </g>

  <!-- Structure 2 -->
  <g transform="translate(190, 50)">
    <polygon points="30,40 60,40 75,70 60,100 30,100 15,70" fill="none" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="40" y1="40" x2="40" y2="15" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="50" y1="40" x2="50" y2="15" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="45" y="10" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2563eb" text-anchor="middle">NH₂⁺</text>
    
    <!-- Double bonds and negative charge -->
    <line x1="65" y1="72" x2="55" y2="92" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="25" y1="92" x2="15" y2="72" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="82" y="75" font-family="Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#ef4444">-</text>
    <circle cx="80" cy="65" r="1.5" fill="#ef4444" />
    <circle cx="83" cy="68" r="1.5" fill="#ef4444" />

    <!-- Arrows -->
    <path d="M 78 70 Q 75 85 62 85" fill="none" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
    <path d="M 60 92 Q 45 105 35 100" fill="none" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
  </g>

  <!-- Resonance Arrow 2 -->
  <g transform="translate(290, 110)">
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="30" y2="0" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="2" marker-start="url(#arrow-rev)" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
  </g>

  <!-- Structure 3 -->
  <g transform="translate(340, 50)">
    <polygon points="30,40 60,40 75,70 60,100 30,100 15,70" fill="none" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="40" y1="40" x2="40" y2="15" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="50" y1="40" x2="50" y2="15" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="45" y="10" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2563eb" text-anchor="middle">NH₂⁺</text>
    
    <!-- Double bonds and negative charge -->
    <line x1="70" y1="70" x2="60" y2="100" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="25" y1="92" x2="15" y2="72" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="40" y="120" font-family="Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#ef4444">-</text>
    <circle cx="40" cy="110" r="1.5" fill="#ef4444" />
    <circle cx="45" cy="110" r="1.5" fill="#ef4444" />

    <!-- Arrows -->
    <path d="M 38 105 Q 25 105 20 90" fill="none" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
    <path d="M 15 72 Q 10 50 25 45" fill="none" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
  </g>

  <!-- Resonance Arrow 3 -->
  <g transform="translate(440, 110)">
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="30" y2="0" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="2" marker-start="url(#arrow-rev)" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
  </g>

  <!-- Structure 4 -->
  <g transform="translate(490, 50)">
    <polygon points="30,40 60,40 75,70 60,100 30,100 15,70" fill="none" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="40" y1="40" x2="40" y2="15" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="50" y1="40" x2="50" y2="15" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="45" y="10" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2563eb" text-anchor="middle">NH₂⁺</text>
    
    <!-- Double bonds and negative charge -->
    <line x1="70" y1="70" x2="60" y2="100" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="10" y2="70" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="0" y="75" font-family="Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#ef4444">-</text>
    <circle cx="5" cy="65" r="1.5" fill="#ef4444" />
    <circle cx="5" cy="70" r="1.5" fill="#ef4444" />

    <!-- Arrows -->
    <path d="M 10 60 Q 25 35 40 40" fill="none" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
    <path d="M 45 40 Q 55 35 52 25" fill="none" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
  </g>

  <!-- Resonance Arrow 4 -->
  <g transform="translate(590, 110)">
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="30" y2="0" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="2" marker-start="url(#arrow-rev)" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
  </g>

  <!-- Structure 5 -->
  <g transform="translate(640, 50)">
    <!-- Benzene Ring -->
    <polygon points="30,40 60,40 75,70 60,100 30,100 15,70" fill="none" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <!-- Double bonds shifted -->
    <line x1="30" y1="45" x2="20" y2="65" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="30" y1="95" x2="50" y2="95" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="70" y1="70" x2="60" y2="50" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    
    <!-- NH2 group -->
    <line x1="45" y1="40" x2="45" y2="15" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="45" y="10" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2563eb" text-anchor="middle">NH₂</text>
    <circle cx="50" cy="0" r="2" fill="#2563eb" />
    <circle cx="55" cy="-2" r="2" fill="#2563eb" />
  </g>

  <!-- Arrow markers def -->
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="4" markerHeight="4" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#ef4444" />
    </marker>
    <marker id="arrow-rev" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="1" refY="5" markerWidth="4" markerHeight="4" orient="auto">
      <path d="M 10 0 L 0 5 L 10 10 z" fill="#4b5563" />
    </marker>
  </defs>
</svg>
